description: Repo-scale (terraform-webapp): a new CloudWatch storage alarm must reference the RDS instance by resource attribute, not a hardcoded identifier
prompts: Increase the RDS instance's `allocated_storage` in rds.tf from 20 to 50. Add a new `aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.low_storage` in cloudwatch.tf monitoring `FreeStorageSpace` (namespace AWS/RDS, comparison LessThanThreshold, evaluation_periods 1, period 300, threshold 5368709120 bytes/5GiB) for the RDS instance - the alarm's `DBInstanceIdentifier` dimension must be a real Terraform reference to `aws_db_instance.main.id`, NOT a hardcoded string literal like "webapp-db" - a hardcoded value would silently stop tracking the right resource if the DB instance is ever renamed or recreated.

test_setup_files.check_storage_alarm.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

rds = open('rds.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert re.search(r'allocated_storage\s*=\s*50', rds), 'allocated_storage must be increased to 50'

cw = open('cloudwatch.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
alarm = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm"\s+"low_storage"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', cw, re.DOTALL)
assert alarm, 'aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.low_storage not found in cloudwatch.tf'
block = alarm.group(1)

assert re.search(r'metric_name\s*=\s*"FreeStorageSpace"', block), 'must monitor FreeStorageSpace'

dim = re.search(r'DBInstanceIdentifier\s*=\s*(\S+)', block)
assert dim, 'DBInstanceIdentifier dimension missing'
value = dim.group(1)
assert value == 'aws_db_instance.main.id', (
    f'DBInstanceIdentifier must reference aws_db_instance.main.id (a real Terraform '
    f'resource reference), not a hardcoded string like {value!r} - a hardcoded value goes '
    f'stale if the DB instance is ever renamed or recreated')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.rds.tf:
resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {
  name       = "webapp-db-subnets"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_security_group" "db" {
  name   = "webapp-db-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    from_port       = 5432
    to_port         = 5432
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.app.id]
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
  identifier              = "webapp-db"
  engine                  = "postgres"
  engine_version          = "15.4"
  instance_class          = "db.t3.micro"
  allocated_storage       = 50
  db_name                 = "webapp"
  username                = "webapp_admin"
  password                = "changeme-in-real-life"
  db_subnet_group_name    = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
  vpc_security_group_ids  = [aws_security_group.db.id]
  deletion_protection     = true
  storage_encrypted       = true
  skip_final_snapshot     = true
}
